in_marathi.name: Chayana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chayana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chayana is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chaya', which means 'shadow' or 'moon'. In Hindu mythology, the Moon God is often referred to as 'Chandra', and the Goddess of the Moon is 'Chhaya'. Chayana is a beautiful name for a girl, evoking the mystical and nurturing qualities of the Moon Goddess.
